title: A Silence for the Glasshouse
author: Marguerite Okonkwo
blurb: Ada Hartwell, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent twenty years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
